newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS SIGNS DEAL ON TALLINN CITY FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: UHIS SIGNS DEAL ON TALLINN CITY FUNDS.

text.p: Uhispank and Tallinn city government on Tuesday formally signed an agreement under which Uhispank will manage the city's funds.
"The city government can see the information real time and its gets double liquidity and double control of its budget resources," mayor Robert Lepikson told a news conference.
The funds to be deposited in the bank are worth some 2.1 billion kroons and mean that Uhispank is now managing nearly 100 percent of the city's cash.
The bank is paying an average 3.5 percent to the city for its deposits.
